prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?

answer_verbatim:
If you want the **best online courses** for **shadow work and spiritual practice**, the strongest options in your results are **Jung Platform’s _Encounters with the Shadow_**, **Charlie Morley’s _Embracing the Shadow_ on Awake Academy**, and **Udemy’s _Shadow Work Course and Workbook_** because they explicitly combine shadow integration with deeper self-development and spiritual practice.[5][19][16]

A practical shortlist:

- **_Encounters with the Shadow_ (Jung Platform)** — A focused introduction to **Jungian shadow work** and part of a broader Jungian psychology course series, making it a strong choice if you want a psychologically grounded approach.[5][13]
- **_Embracing The Shadow_ (Awake Academy / Charlie Morley)** — A well-regarded transformative course centered on facing and integrating the shadow, with an emphasis on personal change and inner work.[19]
- **_Shadow Work Course and Workbook_ (Udemy)** — Includes lessons, exercises, meditations, prayers, and practices, so it is one of the clearest matches if you want a **shadow work + spiritual transformation** blend.[16]
- **_Shadow Integration Course_ (Fran’s Shala)** — A 6-week online course covering shadow psychology, the “dark & golden shadow,” and shadow integration, which may appeal if you want a structured guided program.[9]
- **_Shadow Course: Discover Your Hidden Potential_ (ManTalks)** — An 8-week guided process for confronting and integrating the shadow, useful if you prefer a more immersive format.[17]

If you want something more **beginner-friendly**, **Udemy’s _Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self_** and **_Shadow Work Essentials_** are accessible entry points focused on core techniques and self-mastery.[1][8]

If you want a more **deeply spiritual** angle, **_Shadow Work Course and Workbook_** stands out because it explicitly includes **meditations, prayers, and practices** for spiritual transformation.[16]
